# SQL Interface

> Learn how MongoDB SQL Interface enables you to query MongoDB data using BI tools such as Tableau and Power BI via ODBC and JDBC drivers without learning MQL.

- [SQL Interface Authentication](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/sql-interface/authentication.md): Explore authentication mechanisms for the MongoDB SQL Interface, including SCRAM, X.509, LDAP, GSSAPI, AWS IAM, and OIDC across components and deployments.
- [SQL Interface Changelog](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/sql-interface/changelog.md): Explore feature updates, bug fixes, and changes in MongoDB Atlas SQL Interface drivers and connectors across all versioned releases and compatibility notes.
- [SQL Interface Server Setup](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/sql-interface/connect-with-sql-composable.md): Configure the MongoDB SQL Interface for Atlas or self-managed EA. Includes steps for driver selection and installing the SQL Schema Builder.
- [Connect Your BI Tool](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/sql-interface/connect.md): Connect your BI tool, such as Tableau and Power BI, to your MongoDB Atlas or Enterprise Advanced database using MongoDB custom drivers and connectors.
- [Connect to MongoSQL with a Private Endpoint](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/sql-interface/connect/private-endpoint.md): Learn how to connect to Atlas SQL with a Federated Database Instance private endpoint on AWS or Azure to securely query and access data in MongoDB Atlas clusters.
- [Connect from the MongoDB Shell](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/sql-interface/connect/shell.md): Connect to a federated database instance using MongoDB Shell, with steps for installation, authentication, and query syntax options.
- [Connect from DBeaver](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/sql-interface/dbeaver/connect.md)
- [MongoSQL Errors](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/sql-interface/errors.md): Understand MongoSQL error codes, their causes, and resolutions for schema, parser, and algebrizer errors in SQL queries.
- [Enable the SQL Interface](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/sql-interface/getting-started.md): Enable Atlas SQL Interface by using Quick Start or Advanced Configuration to create a federated database instance.
- [Advanced Configuration](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/sql-interface/getting-started/get-started-advanced.md): Set up a federated database instance in Atlas, import sample data, and connect to query using Atlas SQL.
- [Quick Start](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/sql-interface/getting-started/get-started-quick.md): Enable the Atlas SQL Interface quickly to create a federated database instance for querying cluster data with SQL.
- [MongoDB SQL Interface Overview](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/sql-interface/index.md): Learn how MongoDB SQL Interface enables you to query MongoDB data using BI tools such as Tableau and Power BI via ODBC and JDBC drivers without learning MQL.
- [SQL Interface Driver Setup](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/sql-interface/install-driver.md): Install the MongoDB ODBC or JDBC driver that is required to connect your business intelligence (BI) tool to your MongoDB database.
- [MongoSQL Language Reference](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/sql-interface/language-reference.md): Explore the syntax and semantics of Atlas SQL, including supported clauses, operators, expressions, and functions for working with MongoDB's document model.
- [Migrate to SQL Interface](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/sql-interface/migration-guide.md): Migrate to the SQL interface.
- [Query with MongoSQL Statements](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/sql-interface/query-with-asql-statements.md): Explore Atlas SQL queries with examples using SQL syntax, including advanced techniques like `FLATTEN` and `UNWIND` for nested data.
- [Query with SQL Interface](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/sql-interface/query-with-sql.md): Run SQL-style queries on federated database instances using Atlas SQL Interface for data visualization and reporting with BI tools like Power BI and Tableau.
- [Schema Management](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/sql-interface/schema-management.md): Learn how SQL Interface schema management works and choose the right tool for your deployment type: MongoDB SQL Schema Builder CLI for EA deployments, or Atlas Data Federation.
- [Atlas Data Federation Schema Commands](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/sql-interface/schema/adf.md): Reference for the Atlas Data Federation schema commands that generate, retrieve, set, and remove SQL Interface schemas through mongosh or the Atlas UI, with examples.
- [MongoDB SQL Schema Builder CLI](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/sql-interface/schema/schema-builder-cli.md): Understand how the MongoDB SQL Schema Builder CLI generates schemas for the SQL Interface in Enterprise Advanced self-managed deployments, and learn which flags it accepts.
- [Install the MongoDB SQL Interface](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/sql-interface/sql-interface-install.md): Learn how to install the MongoDB SQL Interface in three steps: configure server setup, install JDBC or ODBC drivers, and connect your BI tool to MongoDB.
- [Transition from Atlas BI Connector to MongoSQL](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/sql-interface/transition-bic-to-atlas-sql.md): Migrate from Atlas BI Connector to Atlas SQL for enhanced data analysis capabilities and cost efficiency.
- [SQL Tutorials](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/sql-interface/tutorials.md): Explore tutorials on connecting to and querying Atlas Data Federation using SQL tools like MongoDB JDBC Driver and DBeaver.
- [Connect to and Query Data with Free SQL Tools](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/sql-interface/tutorials/connect-tutorial.md): Connect to a federated database using MongoDB JDBC Driver and DBeaver, and execute SQL queries on sample data.
